title: fix(agents): avoid extra cleanup waits after cancellation
body:
Related: #149612

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes canceled agent turns waiting through an unnecessary idle timeout when cancellation arrives during cleanup.

## User Impact

Canceled turns stop optional idle waits promptly while required transcript writes and runtime disposal still finish. This does not reset session lanes, replay completed actions, or change provider-generation authority.

This fixes the demonstrated cleanup races; the full provider-reload stall and high memory usage remain unverified.

## Why This Change Was Made

Cleanup now rereads cancellation after draining transcript writes and forwards the cancellation signal into the optional idle wait, including preparation-failure and compaction cleanup. The signal interrupts only that wait; persistence and resource settlement retain their existing ownership and ordering.

## Evidence

- September 19 readiness refresh: rebased onto `a37efbafbec59a00bb1c2e78ad1b2f5927bb01c1` without conflicts. The prior [Goal assertion](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35060262431/job/104680256280) and [chat-pane lint error](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35060262431/job/104680255593) also failed on the exact tested base. Existing upstream repairs [#149765](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/149765) and [#149826](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/149826) are now included; the Goal tests and affected UI lint pass locally. No unrelated source workaround was added.
- Before the fix, the new transcript-drain regression received stale `aborted: false` state, and the already-canceled / canceled-during-idle regressions failed.
- **78 focused tests passed across 8 files on `d245e363c8e6fe5aad0cf70dd57de79d0fe107f4`**, including the previously failing Goal case and covering cancellation timing, late rejection, timer/listener cleanup, actual SQLite write admission, runtime disposal, preparation failure, compaction, and lane timeout safeguards.
- Changed-scope checks passed for all 10 changed files, including production and test typechecks, lint, formatting, and repository guards.
- Independent autoreview found no actionable P0–P2 defects in the implementation; `git range-diff` confirms this refresh is a patch-identical rebase.
- Validated on Linux / Node 26.8.2 with a checkout-owned frozen-lockfile dependency installation. No live Gateway or full reload-to-successor integration test was used; the broader incident remains open.
